q: Your session runs `USE CATALOG dev; USE SCHEMA hr;`. Which table does `SELECT * FROM sales.orders` read?
e: A two-part name is `schema.object`. Only the catalog is taken from the session, so it becomes `dev.sales.orders`.
Special characters such as hyphens must be quoted: `` `finance-eu`.reporting.revenue ``. Capital letters are simply stored as lowercase.

q: Where do you look to find a table called `customers` in any catalog of the metastore?
e: Each catalog's `information_schema` covers only that catalog. `system.information_schema` spans every catalog you can see.

q: What is the path of file `a.csv` in folder `2026` of volume `raw` in schema `sales` of catalog `prod`?
e: Volume paths repeat the three Unity Catalog levels after `/Volumes`, then any folders inside the volume.

q: A company uses one catalog per environment (`dev`, `prod`). What is the main advantage?
o: Business units can each own a separate bucket
The same code runs in both environments by changing only the catalog name, and `prod` can be bound to the production workspace
Analysts automatically see only gold tables
e: Per-environment catalogs keep schema and table names identical across environments, and the catalog is the unit that can be bound to workspaces.
